newsitem.title: USA: Walgreen Co July comparable store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Walgreen Co July comparable store sales up.

text.p: Walgreen Co said Monday comporable store sales rose 8.3 percent in July from a year ago.
Total July sales were $1.10 billion, up from $966.0 million a year ago, the drugstore operator said.
Total pharmacy sales for the month rose 19.5 percent, while rising 14.4 percent at stores open at least a year.
Sales for the first 11 months of the fiscal year through July were $12.24 billion, up from $10.77 billion a year ago. Comparable store sales for that period were up 8.3 percent.
Walgreen shares were up 4/16 at 57-5/16 Monday.
